startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Pages to convert to Markdown. Each URL is scraped on its own, cheapest method first.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: markdown: whole page, boilerplate stripped. markdown_trimmed: extra ad/nav lines removed. html: raw HTML as fetched. html_selectors: cleaned HTML, not converted.

rememberSites.title: Remember what works per site
rememberSites.description: Save which method succeeded on each site to a key-value store in your account (switchback-memory), so later runs skip straight to it. Turn off to start fresh every run.
